title: Builders lesson 1: why most products never launch

linkedin.media_title: Builders lesson 1: why products never launch
linkedin.text:
Most products don't die because the idea was bad. They die because they never ship.

Today starts the Builders track: 100 lessons, one goal. By Launch Day, 4 February 2027, you will have launched something real.

Lesson 1 is about the three traps that stop most builders:

Trap 1: building in secret. Months of work that nobody has seen. Then you discover nobody needed it. Show people early. A sketch on paper is enough.

Trap 2: waiting for perfect. One more feature, one more week, one more redesign. Launch day keeps moving, so it never comes.

Trap 3: no deadline. No date means no pressure, and no pressure means no finish.

The fix for all three is the same: pick a date and tell someone.

Your 2-minute task: write one sentence. "I will launch ______ by ______." Post it in the comments if you want people holding you to it.

I'm building in public alongside you for the next 150 days.
